name: Talking to a fed-up Boop still gets a face
case: The person pokes Boop until it's fed up, then a few seconds later says sorry and that it's doing great. It answers with a face, never none and never a grumpy or angry one: a proud, happy, excited, calm or pleased one for the kind words, or one still a little put out, annoyed.
why: PERSONALITY: talked to, Boop always answers with a face, never none, proud at kind words, whatever its mood. A fed-up mood from pokes mustn't make it ignore you. character/steering/mood/cross.md: saying sorry ends it at once, for calm, with a face that's still a little put out, and the guide reacts with the new mood's face
